text:
Lena Park: quick sync — want to lock the pricing shape for the marketplace private offer + hardware co-sell credit. do we do flat discount or a ramped rebate tied to commit/renewal? @Rajesh can you throw numbers at this? :wave:

Rajesh Singh: leaning toward a ramped rebate tied to committed spend velocity. lower up-front discount, bigger rebate if consumption hits milestones. reduces churn/over-discounting.

Olivia Chen: +1 to ramping. also want a simple "make-good" clause for slow initial consumption months so partners don't get penalized during PoC. simple example tiers below: 
```
Tier 1: $0 - 250,000 => 10% rebate
Tier 2: 250,001 - 1,000,000 => 18% rebate
Tier 3: 1,000,001+ => 25% rebate
Ramp window: 6-12 months from contract start
```

Mike Torres: for hardware bundles, we should convert rebate into appliance credit (applies at invoice). for SI deals, recommend a 9mo ramp window and a clause to re-benchmark at renewal. legal will flag change-of-control and transferability.

Mary (MarketplaceBot): created template mp/private-rebate-onramp-v2 in docs repo: https://redwood.internal/mp-templates/mp/private-rebate-onramp-v2 — please review.

Lena Park: nice — concrete next steps: Rajesh -> forecast model (EOD Fri), Olivia -> draft make-good wording, Mike -> confirm hw credit flow with finance, legal looped for transferability. i'll schedule 30m follow-up Mon 10:00. :thumbsup:
